capacity.participationSensitivity: at each cohort entry or exit, twelve times the minimum constituent 1bp amount from that constituent's 30-complete-day median quote volume ending at D-2; the D-1 gap remains unused
capacity.truthBoundary: UNMEASURED: public daily quote volume cannot prove LOT_SIZE, MARKET_LOT_SIZE, MIN_NOTIONAL, spread, depth, fill probability, or impact

data.boundaryPurge: for an open on D the latest feature bar is D-2 and D-1 is a complete unused gap bar; the first development feature ends 2025-03-01, gap is 2025-03-02, and entry is 2025-03-03; the first holdout feature ends 2025-12-31, gap is 2026-01-01, and entry is 2026-01-02; final liquidation scores are computed but forcibly ignored
data.checksumLaw: hash every shared ZIP and CHECKSUM sidecar and match the official compressed-byte SHA-256 before any member is opened
data.readOnlyReuse: the exact V-G26 public archive corpus is shared read-only; V-G38 writes only quant/research/vg38/** and does not inherit V-G26 outcomes

distinctness.accelerationCurvature: no second difference or curvature term; paths may share a compression ratio while current curvature differs and may share current curvature while compression differs
distinctness.entropy: no histogram, bin, probability, concentration, or entropy term; equal-sign-entropy paths may have different compression ratios
distinctness.level: uniformly multiplying the complete BTC quote-volume path by any positive constant leaves every score unchanged
distinctness.seasonality: no UTC-slot or weekday normalization, comparison, or parameter appears in the score
distinctness.shock: no latest-change, maximum, tail, or threshold shock predicate appears; MAD over two windows is the only dispersion statistic
distinctness.synchronization: only BTCUSDT quote volume enters the score; altering any peer path leaves the score unchanged
distinctness.turnover: quote-volume level and level rank never enter the score or portfolio weights
distinctness.volatilityOfVolume: dispersion is the median absolute deviation of daily log quote-volume changes, not the quote-volume level
distinctness.priceVolumeCorrelation: price and price return never enter the score; arbitrary price-path changes leave it unchanged

execution.alwaysOnComparator: the identical static equal-weight cohort entered at the same first open and liquidated at the same final open under the same cost scenario
execution.entry: score using quote-volume bars only through D-2, leave D-1 unused, enter at D open
execution.exit: when the strictly lagged score is above threshold, exit the entire cohort at D open; every entry requires an authenticated exit
execution.internalRebalancing: none; on entry split current notional equally across all twelve members and hold fixed units until exit
execution.missingConstituentPolicy: terminal UNMEASURED; never partial cohort and never backfill

inference.candidateSelection: highest excess one-sided 95 percent LCB, then absolute LCB, fewer transitions, lower compression threshold, longer baseline, longer recent window, then trial id
inference.dailyObservation: synchronous post-cost simple return of the single cohort-or-cash NAV and excess versus the identical always-on cohort
inference.drawdownObservation: peak-to-trough over starting 1000 cash and every marked daily open; intraday drawdown UNMEASURED
inference.holdoutMultiplicity: one preselected champion opened at most once; no retuning, runner-up, repair, or rerun
inference.interval: Q14 90 percent two-sided circular-block percentile interval; lower endpoint is the one-sided 95 percent LCB
inference.pValueNull: center each seeded circular-block replicate mean by the observed mean and compare with the observed mean
inference.programWideMultiplicity: UNRESOLVED; this packet controls only its frozen eight-trial family

question: Does strictly lagged compression in the volatility of BTCUSDT quote-volume changes identify a post-cost fixed-cohort-or-cash regime with positive absolute and always-on-excess performance?

signal.cohortOrCash: if recent MAD divided by prior MAD is at or below the trial threshold hold the complete frozen cohort; otherwise hold USDT cash
signal.definition: for BTCUSDT only, x_s=ln(Q_s/Q_s-1); compare MAD of the latest recent window with MAD of the immediately preceding disjoint baseline window
signal.degeneracy: prior-window MAD must be strictly positive; otherwise terminal UNMEASURED; recent MAD may be zero
signal.strictLag: for target open D the latest input quote-volume bar is D-2; D-1 and every later field are excluded

universe.cohortLaw: static predeclared benchmark cohort; no ranking, addition, removal, backfill, or current exchangeInfo filter
universe.historicalUniverseLimitation: static retrospective membership may have survivor-selection bias and does not prove a point-in-time market-wide universe
universe.requiredCoverage: every member requires one unique valid contiguous daily bar for every declared day

verdictLaw.GO: all custody, causal, development, Q14 multiplicity, PBO, absolute, excess, stress, drawdown, and activity gates pass and the single holdout passes every frozen gate
verdictLaw.NO_GO: public measurement is valid but any declared economic, statistical, activity, or risk gate fails; development failure leaves holdout unopened
verdictLaw.UNMEASURED: required source hash, schema, timestamp, daily boundary, uniqueness, continuity, causality, run control, or exit proof is invalid or missing
verdictLaw.goScope: PUBLIC_RETROSPECTIVE_SHADOW_RESEARCH_ONLY; never account truth or capital authority
verdictLaw.widerProfitability: UNKNOWN unless accepted by the global attempt ledger and successor scoreboard
